samples.summary: Toolbar "Decrease decimal places" becomes a silent no-op on plain integer/text/empty cells, a behaviour change for the only UI consumer
samples.evidence: formatting-toolbar.tsx:253 calls spreadsheet.decreaseDecimals() -> spreadsheet.ts:546 -> Sheet.changeDecimals(-1). With the new guard (sheet.ts:4198-4203: `if (stepped < 0 && !explicitDp) return;`), a plain cell whose value has no decimals (valueDp = 0, no stored dp) now takes NO write at all. Before the change the same click wrote `{dp: 0, nf: 'number'}` via setRangeStyle, which visibly changed rendering (e.g. '1234' -> '1,234' through formatValue's grouping). The button therefore now does nothing for a whole class of cells, and the frontend gives the user no feedback (it still calls render()/notifySelectionChange()). No frontend code was updated to reflect that the control can legitimately no-op.

samples.summary: Lessons doc still describes the pre-change DefaultStyleValues contract (`dp: 2` present, `dp: 2` self-erasing)
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260818-sheets-decimal-round-trip-lessons.md:13-18 states `DefaultStyleValues` in packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts "carries `dp: 2`, so writing `dp: 2` self-erases". The diff deletes `dp: 2` from that table (style-mutation.ts:19-32), so the cited behaviour no longer exists; a reader following the citation gets the old contract. Line 26 of the same file also names the API `unsetRangeStyleKeys`, while the shipped method is `unsetRangeStyleValues` (sheet.ts:4292).

samples.summary: `isEmptyCell` ignores the spill fields that `compactCell` now preserves, so callers can delete a cell that still carries live spill bookkeeping
samples.evidence: isEmptyCell (style-mutation.ts:48-52) considers only v/f/s. Now that compactCell keeps spillAnchor/spillRows/spillCols/spillBlocked, `compactCell(cell, next)` can return `{ v: '', spillAnchor: 'A4' }` (an empty spill-ghost whose style was just unset) and isEmptyCell still reports true, so both the new path (sheet.ts:4448-4452) and the pre-existing clearCellStylesInRange (sheet.ts:2007-2012) call store.delete on it. The calculator's ghost-clearing loop matches ghosts by `ghostCell?.spillAnchor === sref` (calculator.ts:80, sheet.ts:1018), so a deleted ghost silently drops out of the anchor's block. Fix belongs on isEmptyCell / the new caller, not on compactCell.

samples.summary: Frontend `isDefaultLikeStyle` still treats `dp: 2` as "unset", the distinction this change deliberately makes meaningful
samples.evidence: sheet-view.tsx:62 `const isDefaultDecimalPlaces = style.dp === undefined || style.dp === 2;`, consumed by the paint-format path at sheet-view.tsx:341/347 (a "default-like" source style makes paint format clear the target's formatting instead of copying it). The diff's whole premise (style-mutation.ts:14-17) is that "no stored dp" and "dp: 2" are now distinct states, and dp: 2 is no longer pruned away, so this helper can now classify an explicitly-2-decimal style as default. packages/frontend has no tsc/vitest coverage of this helper's decimal branch.

samples.summary: "Clear formatting" still has no `dp` in its reset patch, so a stored `dp` now survives it more often
samples.evidence: DefaultResetStylePatch (sheet.ts:144-158) lists nf: 'plain' but no dp, and resetRangeStyleToDefault (sheet.ts:3752-3771) relies on it. Previously a `dp: 2` range patch could never exist (pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys erased it); with `dp` removed from DefaultStyleValues such patches now persist, so after Clear formatting the invisible `dp` remains in the range-style layer and reappears the next time the user picks a number format.

samples.summary: `getActiveDecimalPlaces` is an unused sibling that still encodes the old "dp defaults to 2" reading
samples.evidence: Repo-wide grep for `getActiveDecimalPlaces` finds only its definition and doc comment at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4146-4152 — no callers. It returns `style?.dp ?? 2`, which contradicts the new inference rules in getActiveDecimalState; any future caller would reintroduce the residue this change removes. knip does not flag unused class methods.

mergedFrom.summary: Cell rewrite in `unsetRangeStyleValues` still routes through `compactCell`, silently dropping spill metadata the calculator depends on

finding.summary: New cell-level unset path rebuilds cells with `compactCell`, which silently drops spill metadata (`spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked`) that the calculator/renderer depend on
finding.evidence: `removeCellStyleKeysInRange` writes `await this.store.set(anchor, compactCell(existing, next))` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4366). `compactCell` only copies `v`, `f`, `s` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:57-69), while `Cell` also carries `spillRows`, `spillCols`, `spillAnchor`, `spillBlocked` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:209-217), which the array-formula code writes and reads: `sheet.setCell(ref, { v: anchorValue, f: cell.f, s: style, spillRows: rows, spillCols: cols })` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:136) and `if (cell.spillRows && cell.spillCols && !cell.spillBlocked)` in the paint/expansion loops (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:74, packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1086). So decreasing decimals back to the inherited precision over a styled spill anchor erases its spill region metadata until the next recalculation. (Note: `setStyle` at sheet.ts:3682 already has this shape, so the invariant may already be violated elsewhere; the fix belongs in the new code — preserve the non-style fields, e.g. `{ ...existing, s: next }`-style compaction.)

verdict.reason: The finding's core mechanism does not exist in the repository. It claims `compactCell` "only copies `v`, `f`, `s`" and therefore drops spill metadata, but packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:61-85 explicitly copies `spillRows` (69-71), `spillCols` (72-74), `spillAnchor` (75-77) and `spillBlocked` (78-80) from `base` onto the rebuilt cell, with a doc comment at 54-60 stating that intent ("The spill fields travel with the base cell: a style-only rewrite must not detach a dynamic-array anchor from its ghosts"). Grep confirms a single definition of `compactCell` repo-wide, so no shadowing copy explains the discrepancy. The cited call site is also not as quoted: sheet.ts:4366 is a `continue` in a `visited` de-dup check; the real write is sheet.ts:4446-4451, `compactCell(cell, nextStyle)`, where `cell` is the unmodified record read from `this.store.get(anchor)` (4369) and stored in `cellEdits` (4382) — so the spill fields are present in `base` and survive. The corroborating `setStyle` site (sheet.ts:3679-3687) has the same shape and likewise preserves them. Consequently the consumers the finding says would break (calculator.ts:74, calculator.ts:136, sheet.ts:1086) still receive their spill metadata on this path, and no invariant is violated. A separate, narrower concern about `isEmptyCell` (style-mutation.ts:48-52) ignoring spill fields is a different mechanism and is not the claim under review.
